01 /

Choose a strategy

Review the strategy description, minimum allocation and percentage used for each copied pick. These are administrator-managed sports strategies. Their future results are uncertain; a displayed risk label is not a promise of safety.

02 /

Allocate from your wallet

Move an amount from your available wallet balance into a copy position. That allocation is tracked separately. An active position copies future picks published for its strategy; it does not retrospectively copy old games.

03 /

A chart that follows your capital

Your chart starts with the allocation. Settled wins add net profit; losses subtract the copied stake. Pending games leave the chart unchanged. Refunded games leave capital unchanged. The teams, result and net movement appear in the game history beneath it.

  • Chart points can be explored with a pointer, touch or keyboard.
  • Illustrative examples on this website are not a strategy performance record.
04 /

Pause. Review. Return funds.

Pause a position to stop copying new picks. Existing copied stakes still settle. A position with unsettled games must wait before it can close; once eligible, closing returns its remaining funds to your wallet.
